scope: Independent read-only source, prior profiling, test coverage and protocol audit; no Java/build/profiler/performance run.

source.initializationDetail: List iterator mapping becomes indexed reads into predicates to initialize one private IntArray; same ordered property mapping for stable internal predicate Lists. No change to per-node predicates.indices.any or projectedPropertyIndexes.

profiling.newEvidence: Previously recorded frozen-main JFR events were remapped with source/BCI/frame-type metadata, not newly measured candidate benefit.
profiling.contrast136: Rejected136 replaced the per-node range/iterator OR traversal with while. This candidate leaves that traversal unchanged and only changes its property-index storage/access.
limits: BCI positions are not exclusive instruction costs or promised savings.
Trace labels are not proof of unprofiled compilation state.

coverage.ParallelDistinctDisjunctionTest: 4 correctness tests: 16 predicates (4 terms x 4 properties), exclusive/overlap masks, stored-order DISTINCT/LIMIT, selected/null-selected and missing tuple, persisted exact and nonpersisted raw paths, separate transform and expected-term states. Explicit raw scan count assertion.
coverage.GraphStoreTest: Split raw/persisted exact coverage; graphId/null projection; incomplete selected; inline-only and background workers; raw DISTINCT work rejection/interruption checks join workers and preserve interruption. Other unsupported/index/fallback tests cover surrounding dispatch.
coverage.crossGraphBoundary: Existing CrossGraphCypherExecutorTest verifies two-property OR DISTINCT source order/provenance, but does not substitute for pure-four-term mapped multi-graph testing.
coverage.honestGap: The 4 dedicated pure-four tests use one mapped graph and fixed 4-column projection order; arbitrary projection permutations/duplicates/null and pure-four multi-graph are not all crossed in one unit test. Unchanged source and broader tests protect those paths; the required real36 full-output control and conditional v3 pairs supply pure-four single/multi coverage.

sequence: Complete build/tests/detekt/JMH packaging and bytecode validation before timing.
One real36 full values/order/provenance correctness control with hashes.
Original34 three independent C/B B/C C/B pairs, full14field oracle, unchanged regression bounds plus strict global P95 improvement in every pair.
Only old34 pass permits additional real36 three alternating pairs with all full outputs and repeated >15% AND >1ms same-query rejection.
Only local pass permits exact-head complete CI; a failure is recorded then explicitly reverted without retry-to-green.
protocol.sequencingEnforcement: Runner files remain unchanged; root orchestrates old34-before-v3 conditional execution rather than the v3 script automatically checking old34.
